caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular mirror with a wooden frame, supported by two vertical sideposts and resting on two broad, curved feet that extend forward and outward from the base. The wood frame is a warm brown color, suggesting either polished or stained wood, with a distinct inner border in a yellower or more golden tone, giving a contrasting double-frame effect. The reflective surface of the mirror is rendered in muted shades of gray and blue, providing a misty, slightly clouded appearance. At the bottom center of the mirror's frame is a small, greenish plaque with text. The background is plain, off-white, and the mirror is centrally placed, standing alone without other objects around it.
title: Mirror
